SPECIFICATION FOR 
TAPER HANDLES FOR MACHINE TOOLS 

( First Revision ) 



g 

2 

£ 

o 

■o 
o 
o 

s 



1. Scope — Covers dimensions and requirements of taper handles for machine tools. 

2. Types— There shall be six types of taper handles, namely, Type K, L, M, N, P and R as 
shown in Table 1 : 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Material — The taper handles shall be made from free-cutting steel of suitable quality conforming 
to IS : 4431-1978 'Carbon and carbon-manganese free-cutting steel {first revision)'. 

5. Designation — A taper handle of Type K and nominal size / = 80 mm shall be designated as : 

Taper Handle K 80 IS : 2890 

6. Surface Protection — Surface polished. Additional surface protection shall be as agreed to 
between the manufacturer and the user. 

7. Marking — The taper handles shall be marked with its nominal size and the manufacturer's name 
or trade-mark. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 



This standard was first published in 1964 based on DIN 99-1937 which has since been revised. 
The committee responsible for formulation of this standard decided to revise the same to bring it in 
line with DIN 99-1972 'Clamping levers', issued by the Deutsches Institut fur Normung (DIN). In 
| this revision the following changes have been incorporated : 



c 



a) Provision of a pre-drilled hole intended to simplify pinning of the handles for Types K and L 
§ has been retained in accordance with original version of the standard even though there is 



c 

1c 



no such provision in DIN 99-1972; 



S b) Taper handles of / = 40 mm and 50 mm have been included in accordance with 



5 
o 



DIN 99-1972; and 
c) Details regarding surface finish have been included.
